title: 5144 Massachusetts Ave
description: A rare opportunity to acquire an architecturally distinguished 28,700-square-foot church and educational complex on 2.15 acres in one of Bethesda's most prestigious locations, approximately one block from the Washington, D.C. line and near Spring Valley. It is one of only six church properties in Maryland rated four stars out of five by the major commercial real estate databases — and the only one in Montgomery County. The complex includes a main sanctuary, secondary assembly space, a commercial kitchen, classrooms, and offices. The property also generates strong interim income — a Montessori School tenant on a month-to-month lease and Verizon & T-Mobile cellular equipment in the steeple — producing approximately $14,000/mo in total interim revenue. A high-quality institutional asset with immediate cash flow in a premier location.

title: 7272 & 7274 Cradlerock Way
description: Two adjacent two-story townhome office condominiums — approximately 1,781 SF each, or roughly 3,562 SF combined — in Owen Brown Village, near Lake Elkhorn and adjacent to Giant Food and McDonald's with quick access to Routes 29, 32, and 175. Each unit offers a split-level layout with a main-level lobby, three offices/treatment rooms upstairs and three more downstairs, private restrooms on both levels, and a walkout patio. Unit 7272 is also available for lease at $3,500/mo ($27.50/SF modified gross). Purchase either unit individually or both together — ideal for an owner-user or professional practice.

title: 5721–25 Main Street
description: A B1-zoned corner property at Main Street and Furnace Road, improved by an approximately 3,200 SF metal warehouse with five drive-in doors and an approximately 4,612 SF mixed-use office building with a residential component. One block from Route 1 at the entrances to I-895, I-195, and Route 100, roughly seven minutes from BWI-Thurgood Marshall Airport. The properties are listed in the Maryland Inventory of Historic Properties and may qualify for certain historic rehabilitation tax credits, subject to the applicable program requirements and approval. Buyer should independently verify eligibility. Both structures need substantial work — a strong value-add or redevelopment opportunity in a high-visibility location.
